deadline.value: Regular PhD deadline is December 1 (standby applications until late January, reviewed only if space allows); the department fee-waiver request must be in by November 30, 2026.
deadline.quote: the deadline for Regular PhD applications is December 1

gre_general.value: PhD applicants' GRE scores are optional and omitting them does not harm the application.
gre_general.quote: Applicants for the PhD GRE scores are optional; omitting them will not harm your application.

gre_subject.value: PhD applicants' GRE scores (including subject) are optional.
gre_subject.quote: Applicants for the PhD GRE scores are optional; omitting them will not harm your application.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 79 (or 19 on each section of the paper test).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: 79 on the TOEFL iBT or TOEFL iBT Home Edition

ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 7.0 on the IELTS Academic test or IELTS Indicator

fee_waiver.value: PhD applicants with financial need can request a department fee waiver before applying, no later than November 30, 2026.
fee_waiver.quote: PhD program applicants with financial need may apply to have their application fee waived via our department's fee waiver request form.

supervisor.value: Admission is by the graduate admissions committee; no supervisor is arranged before applying.
supervisor.quote: The graduate admissions committee then reviews about 150 files in greater depth

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are offered a renewable Graduate Teaching Associateship (stipend, tuition waiver, health insurance subsidy).
funding.quote: All admitted PhD students are offered a Graduate Teaching Associateships (GTA) during the academic year.

also.quote: All Graduate Associateships and Fellowships come with a competitive stipend, full tuition waiver, and full health insurance subsidy.

entry_route.value: A 4-year bachelor's degree or equivalent is the requirement.
entry_route.quote: 4-year Bachelor's degree or the equivalent from an accredited college or university.
